title: KARE KANO — HIS AND HER CIRCUMSTANCES ACT 1.0
subtitle: Original Soundtrack | King Records KICA-440 | 1998 | Music by Shiro Sagisu
appeal_heading: Sunflowers, First Love, and the Evangelion Composer
appeal_body: The first soundtrack album for Kareshi Kanojo no Jijou (Kare Kano / His and Her Circumstances) — the beloved 1998 GAINAX romantic comedy directed by Hideaki Anno right after Evangelion, with music by Shiro Sagisu, the composer of Evangelion itself. The score carries that unmistakable Sagisu warmth — playful piano, gentle strings and bittersweet melodies for Yukino and Arima's story. The sunflower-pattern jacket is adorable, and the booklet hides a sweet bonus: Pero-Pero the dog snoozing on the inside art. A must for Anno/GAINAX collectors — it pairs perfectly with our Evangelion soundtrack listings!
